ItemID: unavailable; Title: New; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar classic-rock songwriting appeals to me, but I would pass this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having recently listened to Old Sock and Memphis, I would choose this for its relaxed blues-rock sound.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental rock is less appealing than blues and song-focused albums right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Carry On; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Stephen Stills fits my rock interests, but I am not looking for a lengthy retrospective today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Croz; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its reflective songwriting sounds appealing after You Should Be So Lucky, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Muddy Wolf at Red Rocks; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues material fits my interests, though I would choose a studio album this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Witmark Demos: 1962-1964 The Bootleg Series Vol. 9; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Early acoustic demos are not what I want alongside my recent blues-rock listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Le Noise; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The raw guitar and songwriting interest me, but I am in the mood for something more relaxed today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Wings Over America; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic rock appeals to me, but a long live set would not be my choice today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Homo Erraticus; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A progressive-rock concept album feels less relevant to my current blues and roots-rock mood.
